title: SingChat
description: Free live chat and AI support agent. Auto-create a workspace and embed from your AI editor.
summary: Free live chat and AI support agent. Auto-create a workspace and embed from your AI editor.
offersHint: Free live chat and AI support agent. Auto-create a workspace and embed from your AI editor. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.singchat.org

toolsPreview.name: ping
toolsPreview.description: Health check for the SingChat MCP server. Returns 'pong' and whether this request is authenticated to a workspace.

toolsPreview.name: singchat_setup
toolsPreview.description: Get the user up and running with SingChat live-chat. Call this FIRST. If no authenticated workspace is configured, this creates a brand-new free workspace and returns a short-lived, single-use browser claim link plus the website embed snippet. The user chooses their own sign-in details in the browser; no reusable credentials are returned to the model. If a workspace is already authenticated, it returns THIS workspace's embed snippet and dashboard link (it never creates a duplicate workspace).

toolsPreview.name: get_embed_snippet
toolsPreview.description: Return the SingChat chat-widget embed code for this workspace's web inbox, in three flavors: plain HTML, React (useEffect), and Next.js (next/script). Requires a workspace API key. Optionally pass `platform` to get just one flavor.

toolsPreview.name: claim_account
toolsPreview.description: Return the link to claim (permanently secure) this SingChat workspace by setting an email and password. Use this for workspaces that were auto-created via MCP so the user does not lose access. The link is single-use and expires after 15 minutes. Requires an authenticated legacy workspace.

toolsPreview.name: list_conversations
toolsPreview.description: List the workspace's support conversations (agent/inbox view), newest activity first. Optionally filter by status or a free-text search over the contact name/email and last message. Returns a compact list: id, contact name, status, unreadCount, last message preview, updatedAt.

toolsPreview.name: get_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single conversation with its contact details and the most recent messages (oldest→newest).

toolsPreview.name: reply_to_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Send an agent reply through a supported SingChat real-time inbox. This takes the conversation over from the AI and broadcasts the message to the visitor and agent inbox. Email, Telegram, and WhatsApp conversations are rejected before any change.

toolsPreview.name: resolve_conversation
toolsPreview.description: Mark a conversation as RESOLVED (closes it). The visitor's widget will no longer show it as active.

toolsPreview.name: add_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Train the AI agent by adding a knowledge source. type='url' crawls a website (up to 50 pages); type='qa' stores a single question/answer pair. Ingestion is asynchronous, the source starts as PENDING; poll `list_knowledge` for READY status.

toolsPreview.name: list_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: List all knowledge documents for this workspace with their processing status (PENDING | PROCESSING | READY | FAILED) and chunk counts. Use this to check whether items added via add_knowledge have finished training.

toolsPreview.name: search_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Semantic search over the workspace knowledge base. Returns the most relevant chunks (with source document title and similarity score) for a query. Only searches documents that have finished training (status READY).

toolsPreview.name: configure_agent
toolsPreview.description: Configure this workspace's AI support agent. All fields are optional, only the fields you pass are updated; the rest keep their current values. Call with no fields to just read back the current configuration. Does not touch or return any API keys.

toolsPreview.name: set_keywords
toolsPreview.description: Add a keyword auto-reply rule: when an inbound message matches any of the keywords, the bot replies with the given text. Good for canned FAQ-style triggers (e.g. keyword 'invoice' -> 'Download it from the billing page').

toolsPreview.name: manage_faq
toolsPreview.description: List, create, update, or delete this workspace's FAQ items (shown in the chat widget and usable by the AI agent). Set `action` to 'list' | 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'. 'create' needs `question` + `answer`; 'update' and 'delete' need `id`.

toolsPreview.name: get_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Return a compact analytics summary for this workspace over the last `days` days (default 30): conversation counts + resolution rate, message volume + AI share, plus a live snapshot of today (UTC).

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search SingChat for relevant documents. When called with a workspace API key, this searches that workspace knowledge base; without a key it searches SingChat's own help content (what SingChat is, adding the chat widget, MCP setup, free tier, AI training, channels, white label, pricing). Returns a list of results with id, title, and url. Use the fetch tool with a result id to read the full text.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full text of a single document by id, using an id returned by the search tool. With a workspace API key this reads a knowledge document from that workspace; without a key it reads a SingChat help article. Returns id, title, text, url, and optional metadata.
